name: io.github.SentioGate/sentiogate-mcp
title: SentioGate FinOps & LLM Router
description: BYOK AI router & FinOps control plane: audit token waste, check tool safety, and rank models.

tools.name: sentiogate_audit_waste
tools.description: Analyze past LLM request logs (raw JSON/JSONL/CSV or array of message turns) to detect cost waste, unnecessary context bloat, prompt-cache opportunities, and achievable savings with SentioGate.

raw_logs.description: Raw string containing JSON lines, CSV, or formatted request history logs.

records.description: Array of past chat completion request/response records with token counts and model names.

tools.name: sentiogate_get_finops_ledger
tools.description: Fetch real-time SentioGate BYOK FinOps metrics: measured spend by provider, prompt-cache USD savings, active sessions, and remaining 5-hour Community Pool quota.

time_range.description: Time window for cost analytics aggregation (default: 7d).

tools.name: sentiogate_recommend_model
tools.description: Recommend the optimal model and provider fallback chain for a given coding or agent task based on real-time task difficulty, live catalog pricing, and measured latency.

task_prompt.description: The user prompt or instruction to classify and score.

requires_tools.description: Whether the agent workload requires native tool/function calling.

tools.name: sentiogate_guard_check
tools.description: Pre-flight check tool calls, terminal commands, or conversation history against SentioGate Armor security rules (credential leakage, destructive rm, pipe-to-shell, git force-push, and runaway tool loops).

tool_name.description: Name of the tool (e.g. bash, exec_command, curl, send_email).

arguments.description: JSON-encoded arguments or raw shell command string.

messages.description: Optional conversation messages array to check for stuck/repeating agent tool loops.

tools.name: sentiogate_optimize_payload
tools.description: Preview and simulate context compaction and tool-output trimming on an array of conversation messages without executing upstream model inference.

messages.description: Array of OpenAI-format chat messages to test optimization on.

tools.description: Optional array of OpenAI/MCP tool definitions to estimate deferred tool-search schema savings.

tools.name: sentiogate_delegate_prompt
tools.description: Route a chat completion sub-task through SentioGate (using model "auto" or a pinned provider/model) or enqueue it on the background batch queue.

prompt.description: The user prompt or sub-task instruction to execute.

model.description: Model ID (default: "auto" for automatic cost/tier routing).

async_batch.description: When true, enqueues the request on the async batch queue (/v1/batch/enqueue) instead of waiting synchronously.
